title: Atlas: Optimizing Deployment of Compound AI Workflows on Heterogeneous Clusters
abstract: arXiv:2609.04513v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compound AI workflows are increasingly used to serve complex AI tasks by coordinating multiple AI models and software components. This approach enables deployment flexibility, as each workflow stage can expose different model variants and resource requirements, but it also expands the deployment choices. A deployment must choose an execution plan that selects AI models for each compound AI workflow stage and places them on a heterogeneous cluster in order to satisfy SLOs. Deployment optimizers therefore need estimates to compare many candidate plans and identify feasible ones. System metrics can often be profiled per stage and composed according to workflow topology, but accuracy cannot, as errors and information loss at upstream stages affect the accuracy of downstream stages. translated_title: Atlas：在异构集群上优化复合AI工作流的部署
translated_abstract: 复合AI工作流越来越多地被用于通过协调多个AI模型和软件组件来服务复杂的AI任务。这种方法提供了部署上的灵活性，因为每个工作流阶段可以呈现不同的模型变体和资源需求，但同时也扩大了部署选择的范围。一次部署必须选择一个执行计划，为每个复合AI工作流阶段选择AI模型，并将其放置在异构集群上，以满足SLO（服务级别目标）。因此，部署优化器需要估计值来比较众多候选计划并识别可行的计划。系统指标通常可以按阶段进行性能分析，并根据工作流拓扑进行组合，但准确度却不能，因为上游阶段的误差和信息丢失会影响下游阶段的准确度。现有方法要么对完整配置进行端到端的性能分析，这种方式的扩展性较差，要么使用将各阶段视为相互独立的基于乘积的准确度替代模型。
tldr: 本文提出Atlas系统，通过为复合AI工作流的各阶段选择合适的AI模型并优化其在异构集群上的放置位置，以低成本地比较众多候选执行计划并满足SLO目标。
en_tdlr: Atlas optimizes the deployment of compound AI workflows on heterogeneous clusters by efficiently comparing candidate execution plans that select AI models per stage and place them to satisfy SLOs.
